task: Get ready to pick stuff up and put it in places, because you've just entered TextWorld! First of all, you could, like, head east. And then, make an effort to take a trip east. And then, go south. Next, travel west. And then, make an attempt to go west. After that, attempt to go south. And then, take a trip south. Then, make an effort to travel west. And then, take a trip north. Then, try to travel west. Then, pick up the passkey from the rack. And if you do that, you're the winner!
description:
Fancy seeing you here. Here, by the way, being the cubicle. Let's see what's in here.



You need an unguarded exit? You should try going east. There is an unguarded exit to the south. You need an unblocked exit? You should try going west.

thought: I should go east as the first step to follow the instructions.
feedback:
You find yourself in a bedroom. A normal one.

You make out a closed dresser.

There is an exit to the east. Don't worry, it is unguarded. You don't like doors? Why not try going west, that entranceway is unblocked.
